name: SQL
note: Declarative query language based on relational algebra
typeSystem: Dialect-dependent. Most engines assign declared types to columns and type-check expressions, with implicit conversions and SQL NULL's three-valued logic; SQLite uses dynamic value typing with column affinity.

typeSystemExample.caption: Typed columns and GREATEST as the closest to generic max

runtime: Parsed, planned, optimised, and executed by a database engine

runtimes.name: Database query engine
runtimes.role: Each engine (PostgreSQL, SQLite, MySQL...) parses, plans, and executes queries.

compilers.name: Query compiler / planner
compilers.role: Transforms SQL into an execution plan; engines may execute an operator plan, virtual-machine bytecode, generated native code, or a combination.
